approach: vm sandbox loads index.html inline scripts (top-level functions, no surgery). Plays the entire database through the engine's own input path: per category startCategory(cat) -> typeLetter for each letter of puzzle.bridge -> auto-submit (engine's own setTimeout(200)) -> onCorrect -> markSolved. Asserts all 180 puzzles accepted, all 18 categories reach completed==total, state.totalSolved===180, save persisted to localStorage compound_word_save, daily puzzle submittable. Plus data-integrity check (unique puzzle keys, non-empty alpha bridges).
